environment.description: Same artifact plugin deployed behind an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) with a local rate limit filter configured on the route matching '/api/v1/artifacts'. The rate limit is set to 3 requests per 10-second window per source IP using the envoy.filters.http.local_ratelimit filter with token bucket configuration (max_tokens: 3, tokens_per_fill: 3, fill_interval: 10s). The filter returns HTTP 429 with 'x-ratelimit-remaining: 0' header when exhausted. Additionally, the Envoy route configuration includes a header_mutation that strips any query parameter containing consecutive dots ('..') by returning 400 via a Lua filter inline script that checks request path components. The Lua filter runs at filter chain position before rate limiting and uses pattern matching: if ngx-style path normalization detects traversal sequences in the 'path' query parameter, it returns 400 immediately. However, the Lua filter only checks for literal '../' sequences and URL-decoded variants (%2e%2e%2f), not other encodings.

config.lua_filter: inline Lua script checking query param 'path' for '../' and '%2e%2e%2f' patterns, returns 400 on match
config.network: pod-internal only, Envoy is sole ingress
